hints.title: Sliding Window Modular Hash
hints.text: Maintain the value of the k-digit substring modulo m using Horner rule.

hints.title: Rolling Modulo Transition
hints.text: Advance window: new_val = (old_val - s[i - 1] * 10^(k-1)) * 10 + s[i + k - 1] modulo m.

hints.title: Check Divisibility
hints.text: If the window value modulo m is 0, the current starting index is good.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Rolling hash avoids large integer string parsing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing substrings int(s[i:i+k]) takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects rolling hash / Horner rule modulo m.
